settings.heading: Getting your order to you.
settings.text: How your order is delivered depends on what you're buying and where it's going. Here's how it works.

settings.title: Australia-wide post from $9.95
settings.text: Tools, silicone, tapware, shower sets, towel rails and other small boxed items post anywhere in Australia by tracked Australia Post, priced by parcel weight: up to 250 g $9.95, up to 500 g $11.95, up to 1 kg $15, up to 3 kg $20, up to 5 kg $24.95, heavier parcels by weight. Basins, mirrors, sinks and niche boxes go the same way. Free on WA orders over $100 and on orders over $180 anywhere in Australia. Exact prices show at checkout.

settings.title: Perth local delivery
settings.text: Tiles, vanities, baths, toilets and shower screens are delivered locally across the Perth metro area. Delivery options and costs show at checkout. Tiles are not shipped outside Perth.

settings.title: Free pickup from Maddington
settings.text: Choose local pickup at checkout. Wait for our email saying your order is ready, then book a pickup time — Monday to Saturday, 4:30–9 pm.

settings.title: Build your order
settings.text: Add what you need to the cart. Use the tile calculator to get quantities right.

settings.title: Choose delivery or pickup
settings.text: Perth local delivery, Australia-wide post from $9.95 (free on WA orders over $100 and on orders over $180 elsewhere), or free pickup: the options for your address show at checkout.

settings.title: We confirm
settings.text: For large, heavy or regional orders we may contact you to confirm the delivery details.

settings.title: Receive or collect
settings.text: Check everything on arrival and let us know straight away if anything's damaged.

settings.heading: Common questions.
settings.text: Need a delivery quote before ordering? Call or email the team.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, for small items. Tapware, accessories and other small boxed items ship to New Zealand, the United States, the United Kingdom and the UAE by tracked Australia Post, from $34. Prices are in AUD, and any import duties or taxes are paid on delivery. Tiles and large items are delivered within Australia only.

settings.question: Can I get tiles delivered outside Perth?
settings.answer: Tiles are delivered within the Perth metro area only. For regional WA, contact us and we'll let you know your options.

settings.question: How long will delivery take?
settings.answer: Timing depends on stock, the carrier and your location. Any timeframe we give is an estimate — see our shipping policy for details.
